title: Fabric sourcing
short: Knit fabric sourced and inspected against your construction, GSM and colour.
detail: We source knit fabric against the specification agreed at quotation. Fabric is checked for shade consistency across the lot before cutting begins, because a shade variation found after cutting cannot be undone.

title: Cutting
short: Pattern laid and cut to the approved size set.
detail: The size breakdown you supply drives the cutting plan directly. Laying the full size set together is what keeps consumption efficient on smaller runs.

title: Branding
short: Your artwork applied by whichever method suits it.
detail: This is a fork in the process, not a queue. A garment takes one method — occasionally two, such as an embroidered chest with a printed back — chosen from the artwork, the quantity and the fabric. Every method below runs in our own unit, which is why a small order does not sit waiting in an outside vendor's queue.
branchNote: One of these per garment — not all of them
timing: Sublimation prints the fabric before assembly. Screen and embroidery run on cut panels or finished garments. DTF and DTG are applied to the finished garment.

title: Stitching
short: Assembly on our own line, with your labels and tags placed.
detail: Assembly happens on our line, not a subcontractor's. Neck labels, care tags and size tags are attached during assembly to your placement instruction.

title: Checking & ironing
short: Piece-by-piece inspection, measurement check, pressing and finishing.
detail: Every piece is inspected, not a sample of the lot. Measurements are checked against the approved spec, loose threads removed, then pressed.

title: Packing & dispatch
short: Folded and packed to your specification, then dispatched.
detail: Folding, bagging and carton marking follow your packing instruction. Size ratio per carton can be set to how you intend to distribute the goods.
